name: hs-cTnI Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of hs-cTnI using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of Cardiac Troponin I (cTnI) in human serum, plasma and whole blood samples. This test is used as an aid in the diagnosis of myocardial injury such as Acute Myocardial Infarction (AMI), Unstable Angina, Acute Myocarditis and Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS). For professional and laboratory use only.
